flow_name: B2B Portal Authentication (UAE PASS Identity Gateway)

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Login page -> Click 'Sign in with UAE PASS' -> UAE Pass portal login with EID/mobile/email -> Push notification 2-digit challenge -> (Approve or Cancel) -> Interstitial progress -> Organization Selection / Dashboard 360.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: UAE Pass mobile biometric approval is external. In automated test environments, the UAE Pass sandbox API or mock IdP confirms the session upon challenge submission.

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to the B2B Portal login page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The login page loads with the 'Sign in with UAE PASS' option visible

canonical_steps.action: Click the 'Sign in with UAE PASS' button
canonical_steps.target: //button[contains(.,'Sign in with UAE PASS') or contains(.,'Sign In with UAE PASS')]
canonical_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the UAE PASS identity gateway login screen

canonical_steps.action: Enter Emirates ID, registered email, or UAE mobile number and submit
canonical_steps.target: //input[@placeholder='Emirates ID or email address or UAE mobile number'] | //input[@id='user-id-field']
canonical_steps.expected_result: Identity is validated, and the 2-digit push challenge screen is displayed

canonical_steps.action: Verify the two-digit push confirmation challenge displayed on screen
canonical_steps.expected_result: The challenge code card is displayed, prompting the user to match the number in their UAE PASS mobile app

canonical_steps.action: Optionally click 'Cancel Request' to simulate user aborting login
canonical_steps.expected_result: The 'User Cancelled the login' screen is shown with options to retry or go back to login

canonical_steps.action: Verify interstitial 'Authentication in Progress' state upon app approval
canonical_steps.expected_result: The animated spinner confirms profile validation and session token generation

canonical_steps.action: Select the target organization if prompted on multi-organization screen
canonical_steps.expected_result: The organization is chosen and the authenticated session lands on Dashboard 360

canonical_steps.action: Verify the authenticated B2B Portal Dashboard is displayed
canonical_steps.expected_result: Dashboard 360 is loaded showing full visibility of accounts and company metrics
